levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: needs_ruling: al-Faqih states his routes («رويته عن ...») to a source, with no saying (rule 11). The two groups are his two route statements as written.
«أبي» is the author's father, named only by relation; «رضي الله عنهم» and «رحمهم» are blessings and are left out.
The same text repeats «محمد بن علي بن محبوب» three times; the occurrence numbers pick the one each route ends on.
